system.longDesc:
Requirement: Digital Arcana (Expert)

Cost: 8 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 14

Test: None

You cause a single digital device you can touch or see within 20 yards of you to malfunction, either shutting down completely, freezing, or acting erratically (your choice) for up to a minute. At the GM’s discretion, electronically shielded devices may impose a penalty to your power test. You can spend 4 PP to extend the duration of gremlins another minute if you do so before the initial duration expires.
